book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: رجل تجوز مرا بسيطة وطيبة وكل الناس حبتها.
sentences.en: A man married a simple, kind woman whom everyone loved.

sentences.ar: كان عندها عيب واحد بس بنظره.
sentences.en: She had only one fault in his eyes.

sentences.ar: كل ليلة تقعد تفرجه إياها وتفرح فيها.
sentences.en: Every evening she would sit showing it to him, delighted.

sentences.ar: كان يقول لها: هاي مش حقيقية.
sentences.en: He used to say to her: these are not real.
And she would laugh and say: but I like them.
She died suddenly of a chest illness.

sentences.ar: بعد شهور، ضاق حاله وقرر يبيع المقلد.
sentences.en: After months, he was in straits and decided to sell the false pieces.

sentences.ar: التاجر تطلع بالعقد وسأله: من وين هاد؟
sentences.en: The jeweller looked at the necklace and asked: where is this from?
He said to him: from my wife.

sentences.ar: التاجر قال: هاد حقيقي، وتمنه كبير كتير.
sentences.en: The jeweller said: this is real, and its price is very great.

sentences.ar: الرجل قعد عالكرسي وما قدر يحكي.
sentences.en: The man sat on the chair and could not speak.

sentences.ar: صار غني بيوم، وما عاد يعرف مين كانت مرته.
sentences.en: He became rich in a day, and no longer knew who his wife had been.
